'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male professor who teaches in a very fast pace.

{{color|help|Players can attend Professor Gauss class at <nowiki>06:00-12:00</nowiki> in the Voidmatters Classroom.}}

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Gauss:''' On the left of page 77, look at the waveform equation for the Voidmatter signal in the "y" channel. You only need to define the constant "a"...
:'''Plott:''' Mr. Gauss! Mr. Gauss! Wait!

==Dialogue==
;Sit down
:'''Rover:''' I know this class...
:{{DIcon}} (Pay close attention.)
::'''Gauss:''' From here, the process is simple, and I'm sure you've all deduced that for "F," considering the two initial factors...
::'''Plott:''' Mr. Gauss! You haven't explained what the "a" range is yet...
::'''Gauss:''' So, as you can plainly see, this equation determines the Voidmatter signal's damping threshold for the "y" channel within the Exostrider's neural Resonance...
::'''Gauss:''' Your task is to find me a general solution for it in the next half hour.
::'''Amodeo:''' Half an hour!
::'''Plott:''' But, Mr. Gauss! The equation alone takes up at least half a page!
::'''Gauss:''' It only took me ten minutes to write this part...
::Time flies as the professors give their lecture. The bell rings before you even realize...
:;<nowiki>(Time becomes 12:00)</nowiki>
:{{DIcon}} (Doze off.)
:;<nowiki>Time becomes 16:00)</nowiki>
{{Dialogue End}}
